notes.title: Death Ecology DLC available NOW!
notes.content:
New Content:

1. DLC: Death Ecology
Use Shadow Stone to visit Death Ecology. The monsters will grow stronger as time goes on. Once you die you will quit Death Ecology automatically. Or use a more friendly to get back into the Setting.

2. New Items
Shadow Stone: Use it to visit death. (Collect it from Bosses or your own death) 
Ores: Hell Stone, Prison Stone, Shadow Brick
Animals: Raduck, whom you can collect Black Feather from
Plants: Revive Grass, you can collect Silver Leaf from them.
Plants: Lotus Leaf and its seed
Fish: Multi-clawed fish
Howlite: Each Ecology will randomly refresh Howlite now

3. Potions
Mandala Potion: Burn yourself but increase the damage you do
Black Feather Scroll: Summon a Shadow Warrior to fight for you
Thorn Potion: Summon thorns when you attack
Revive Potion: Use it to revive your defeated companions instantly

4. New Monsters: you can collect Shadow Badge from them
Demon Monk: Do great burning damage
Pig Demon: A brutal demon that scavenges on flesh and blood.
Mountain Ghost: Acquire a shield while moving

5. New Buildings: These blueprints should be exchanged in the God of Snake Altar
Shadow Generator: Transforming vicinity into Shadow landform.
Phantom Arena: You can challenge other players' phantoms here and upload your score.
Shield Generator: Add shields to buildings nearby.
Revive Grass Field: Grow over turns, harvest Revive Grasses when they matured.
Water Channel: For culturing aquatics, will automatically produce fish of current ecology
Lotus Leaf: decoration.

6. New Villager: Maid
Now you can hire a maid to help collect resources.

Click the link below to check out Death Ecology DLC:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237730/_/

notes.title: Craft Hero | Dungeon Update
notes.content:
【Dungeon is available now】

1. Introduction:
The entrance of the dungeon will open to you at the first time you enter Nightmare Biome. The entrance will be set randomly on the map. In the dungeon, you will counter different types of monsters. Defeat them to collect Dungeon Coin, use them to strengthen yourself in the dungeon store and challenge the next floor. 

2. About dungeon stores:
Bloody Worship Table: Randomly increase the attributes of a mercenary on the field (HP +4 or damage +1)
Bloody Rune Table: Randomly strengthen a Rune or a Stamp you equip；
Bloody Weapons Box: Get a rare weapon. The deeper the dungeon is, the higher the level of the weapon you will get.
Bloody Enchanting Table: Enhance a random weapon or armor you equip with a rare characteristic. The deeper the dungeon is, the higher the level of the characteristic you will get.
Ancient Document: There may be some blueprints.

3、About enhanced characteristics: 
Weapon：
Cleave: Your attack will do damage to nearby enemies of the target.
Thunder Worship: A thunder will help you attack one nearby enemy when you are moving.
Fanatical: Increase your damage while consecutively attacking enemies

Secondary Weapon：
Mana Control: Decrease the mana consumption of skills；
Bloodthirsty Blade: Eliminate enemies whose HP is lower than a certain number. 
Master Mark: Increase the damage of your skill.

Armor：
Vengeful Spirit： Summon a Soul Marionette to help while under attack.
Blood Conversion： Recover your mana while under attack.
Storm Rage： Summon a thunder to counterattack while under attack.

New Buildings:
Find the blueprints in the Ancient Documents and get our home some new buildings!
Void Brick: Carefully smelted magic block, craftable at advanced furnaces
Mana Emitter: Absorb the surrounding mana and transmit it with infinite distance, but the efficiency is not very high
Storage Station: Transmit stored mana to nearby devices
Void Crossbow: With a wider attack range and decrease the damage of enemies. 

【Halloween Visitor】

Halloween is coming! And so are pumpkins and witches! Explore them on the map!

notes.title: Nightmare Biome Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/d43fe1ccb113e5270b77054d968dff52a4f0e841.png[/img]

1. Nightmare Biome: Brand-new landscapes, resources, props, buildings and monsters for the brave to experience and challenge

2. Collection
1.Ghost Stone: Nightmare tile material, which can be used to research and build Nightmare buildings
2. Evil Spirit Brick: Nightmare block material, which can be used to research and build Nightmare buildings
3. Void Crystal: Nightmare ore, materials for synthesizing Void Sculpture, Evil Sculpture, Nightmare Sculpture, Ancient God Liner, Tusk Embellishment, and Bone Shield
4. Void Stone: Nightmare rare ore, which can be used to research and build Nightmare buildings
5. Evil God Skeleton: Nightmare collection materials, materials for synthesizing the ancient god linings
6. Mirror Flower: Nightmare collection materials, materials for synthesizing purification potions
7. Ghost Grass: Nightmare collection materials, materials for synthesizing escape medicine
8. Skeleton fish: Nightmare Fish
9. Yellow Gem: It is obtained with a low probability when collecting Void Crystals, and with a low probability of mining in Void Ecology
10. Potential Potion: Exchange it at the Ape God Altar of Nightmare Ecology, and can randomly increase the attribute by a bit after use


3. Breeding
1. Soul beast: produce a mask
2. Mask: the material of the synthetic bone guard
3. Nightmare Hound: Produces fangs
4.Tusk: Materials for fangs pattern

4. Add monsters
Cacodemon: Increases the health and damage of nearby monsters upon death
Corrupted Soull: Increases the health and damage of nearby monsters while acting
Undead Knight: Teleports a distance after being hit
Devil God's Eyes: Monsters that Master the Power of the Void
Void Beast: The Void Master who was born with the world
Arrogant Heavenly King: The Heavenly King transformed from his former companion Naurida into blackness. After defeating him, he will drop the memory of the hero's life experience.
Phantom Demon King: The evil demon king who created the Seven Heavenly Kings, can summon necromancers, and after defeating them will drop memories of the hero's life experience

5. New buildings
1. Void Institute: Extract the power of the void to unlock more technologies
2. Transfer box: collect designated items from nearby equipment
3. Recycler: Collect specified items in nearby equipment and convert them into magic energy
4. Void Smelter: Rebuilt from an energy storage furnace, a furnace that can synthesize more items
5. Void Oven: Rebuilt from an energy storage oven, an oven that can synthesize more items
6. Void Workbench: Rebuilt from an energy storage workbench, a workbench that can synthesize more items
7. Holy Tablet: Reduce the strength of incoming monsters
8. Nightmare Generator: Turn the vicinity into a Nightmare Landscape
9. Mirror Flower Field: Produce Mirror Flowers
10. Ghost grass Field: produce ghost grass
11. Void cage: used to raise creatures from the nightmare ecology
12. Auto-Void Cage: Automatically hatch designated nightmare creatures
13. Enhanced Fire Tower: Burn incoming enemies
14. Super Lightning Generator: Consume more magic energy to cause more damage
15. Auto-Repairer : Automatically repair nearby buildings

6. Synthetic props
1. HP Potion: Can restore a lot of health
2. Mana Potion: Can restore a lot of mana
3. Pue Potion: Remove a Mark of Shame
4. Escape Potion: Teleport to a random location after use
5. Void Chip: Upgrade your main hand equipment to level 5
6. Evilweave Chip: Upgrade your off-hand equipment to level 5
7. Wraith Sculpt: Increases your clothing armor to level 5
8. Plate of the Great Old God: Make your main hand equipment get golden attribute blessing
9. Fangs Ornament: make your off-hand equipment gain golden attribute blessing
10. Bone Plate: Make your clothing and armor get golden attribute blessing
11. Brilliant Gem: dawn immediately after use
12. Magnetic Fishing Rod: you can catch some minerals in the water
13. Blade of Berserker: Recover own health when attacking
14. Archmage's Staff: Recover own mana when attacking

notes.title: Burning Lava Coming | Use Biome Conventor to Change Environment!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/3b1f30c166f44f04da3b8cddcbd80bcb6bacc86c.png[/img]

Burning Lava is running to you！
Heroes, get ready for the new challenge！

-----------------------------
[h2][b]【Mobs】[/b][/h2]
-----------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/d78e70cdab431fe45f171c97c59769c69fad0e89.png[/img]

1. Rock Giant: Monster of great mana and hard rock, its ATK will increased after being attacked
2. Rock Beast: Beast covered by hard rocks, its normal attack can do fire damage
3. Tomb Watcher: The obsessive undead, who have guarded the evil tomb for thousands of years, can use long-range spell damage
4. Death God: The supreme commander who leads the invading monsters. It can call Tomb Watchers to assist in the battle
5. Lord of Lust：Story boss of Lava Environment. Mysterious and strong.
6. Another two mysterious Lords: Lord of Laziness on Tundra and Lord of Rage on Lava

-----------------------------
[h2][b]【Buildings】[/b][/h2]
-----------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/2d8242df3eededd10b8f838db23009ff301613b9.png[/img]

1. Biome Conventor: those scientists finally invented some useful stuff, you can use these machines to turn an area into a specific landfrom.
2. Auto Workbench & Auto Furnace: these machines can automatically craft specific itmes, saving your time to steal eggs.

-----------------------------
[h2][b]【Resources】[/b][/h2]
-----------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/de2bfb90a6ca0ece5ad822f997e0ad67f3c6d40d.png[/img]

1. Molten Lava: basic material to craft Ash Stone
2. Volcanized Rock: basic material to craft Ash Stone and build Flame Pepper Field and Greenhouse
3. Sulfur: Basic material to craft Glowing Stone
4. Purple Gem: Precious gem, can be used to craft multiple advanced stuff
5. Flame Pepper: Can be used to cook Flame Fish Soup
6. Stone Scale Fish: Its fish scale is as hard as stone, but you can still use it to feed yourself

-----------------------------
[h2][b]【Livestock】[/b][/h2]
-----------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/34690e9b2a2458cb0c389fa12d93a3b81e432792.png[/img]

1. Soul Weed: Unique animals on Lava, can produce Herb 
2. Herb: Product of Soul Weed
3. Lava Slime: Unique animals on Lava, can produce Magma Barrel
4. Magma Barrel: Product of Lava Slime
-----------------------------
[h2][b]【Craft】[/b][/h2]
-----------------------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/c7e0671d235c83147290325bfaa13b28b2e3b41a.png[/img]

1. Ash Stone: Important material to upgrade Super Fort
2. Glowing Stone: Important material used to upgrade Furnace and Workbench and to craft top weapons 

-----------------------------
[h2][b]【Items】[/b][/h2]
-----------------------------

1. Mirror Shield(Accessory): Consume several shields to counter magic damage for once
2. Flame Fish Soup: Adds fire damage to the next normal attack

We hope you enjoy Craft Hero - Lava update, and as usual, find us in [url=https://discord.gg/FysGaGKfFe]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think!

notes.title: 0.2.02 Update | Some food and adjustment + Walkthrough Event
notes.content:
【May.24th, 2022 Update】

--------------------------- New Content ---------------------------

1. More choices on your recipes
a. Rotten Egg Fried: Eating this food can bring the evening come instantly
b. Arctic Fish Fillet: Recover Stamina and Mana 
c. FF potion: Drink this potion to make time go faster

2. Optimize chatting system：
a. You can now close the chatting surface so you won't receive any message
b. Scrolling message won't bother you any more

3. Fix an issue that quick building won't consume material correctly

5. Increase the storage upper limit of Mana Furnace, now you can forge 10k props in one time.

We hope you enjoy Craft Hero. And as usual, find us in [url=https://discord.gg/FysGaGKfFe]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Tundra Update is Live + 25% OFF
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/8660913814a23c9ae318e14387ac274a7f72a727.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tundra is live! [/h1]
We are proud to present to you our first major update!
Check it out below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/0cb6c2792167578b99b4033ba3c51a6fdec12c4c.png[/img]

----------------------------[b][h2]【Mobs】[/h2][/b]----------------------------

[olist]
[*] [b]Snow Fairy[/b]: Reduce you and your defense building ATK - Try to beat them quickly
[*] [b]No.4 Robot[/b]: Armed with dual shields, try to use magical defense on them.
[*] [b]No.5 Robot[/b]: Armed with dual drills, breaks armors.
[*] [b]Dr. Devil[/b]: Summons more Robot, a good source of material
[*] [b]Lord of Greed[/b]: Ugly ass Dark Lord, drops the memory clip of the Hero
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/5de7d20dc8b5e60be220acb51fe7acf855980aa1.png[/img]

----------------------------[b][h2]【Buildings】[/h2][/b]----------------------------

[olist]
[*] [b]Academy[/b]: Unlock Tundra techs and buildings
[*] [b]Advanced Process Table[/b]: Craft stuff from Tundra Biome
[*] [b]Mana Sucker:[/b] Automatically sucks the resource nearby - your key tool to an automated empire.
[*] [b]Enhanced Oven[/b]: Capable of melting the ice, leading to more cusines!
[*] [b]Vanilla Field[/b]: Grows Vanilla. Might also grow bugs.
[*] [b]Cherry Field[/b]: Grows Cherry. Probably also grow bugs.
[*] [b]Snow Pine[/b]: Chop it to gain woods and bugs.
[*] [b]Advanced Crystal Lamp[/b]: Speed up the growth of the fields, and [b]Prevent Bugs[/b]!
[*] [b]Snow House[/b]: A home for Tundra animals.
[*] [b]Mana Barrier[/b]: Upgrade from Heavy Barrier, deals magical damage to enemy attacking it.
[*] [b]Flame Tower[/b]: Consumes limestone oil, and burns the enemies.
[*] [b]Castle[/b]: [strike]Flag it![/strike] Increase damage of nearby tower.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/7c8d197180854dfe21a5bf0770a38549964e68f6.png[/img]

----------------------------[b][h2]【Items】[/h2][/b]----------------------------

1. Snow Blocks: Building material for Vanilla and Cherry Field.
2. Ice Brick: Material for Cooling part and Snow House.
3. Stone Mushroom: Ingredient for various potions.
4. Vanilla: Ingredient for Super Pumpkin Burger
5. Cherry: Ingredient for potions
6. Arctic Fish：Fresh Sashimi even out of water for a couple of days

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/355d89d8e770a48a4473616e86f4ab80e57afdf8.png[/img]

----------------------------[b][h2]【Livestock】[/h2][/b]----------------------------

[list]
[*] Enhanced Snow Beast: Produces Mechanical Core, probably from its inner body, key to advanced defense.
[*] Flower Monster: Produces Soul Petal, not sure what it is for.
[/list]

----------------------------[b][h2]【Full Update Note】[/h2][/b]----------------------------
[list]
[*] Added Tundra Biome: Defeat Dessert Lord and Lord of Gluttony, and then use the Crystal Statue to enter Tundra!
[*] Added Toolbar: The long waited Toolbar is finally here! Put your item into it!
[*] Added Follower - Necromancer: By chance summon a ghost when in battle
[*] Added a cute little cursor.
[*] Added a hint to check memory scroll after defeating Dark Lords.
[*] You can now Right-Click to close a UI page or cancel stuff - Hooray! 
[*] Added Signs - Use them to decorate your base.
[*] Added a slightly more tolerable moving sound for passing grass.
[*] Adjusted enemy growth in the mid-term, they will become unstoppable even later now.
[*] Fixed sometimes chat boxes, notes, and other words staying on the screen longer than they should
[*] Fixed further server connection issue (Steam now directs you to server based on your IP instead of language) 
[*] Fixed various rare occasion that leads to a black screen.
[/list]

There is also one major English localization fix coming soon that will clear many unclear wordings. 

We hope you enjoy Craft Hero - Tundra update, and as usual, find us in [url=https://discord.gg/FysGaGKfFe]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think!

notes.title: 【Update Preview】Tundra is Coming | Redeem Code Event
notes.content:
Heroes! I bring good news from the future…
We will be at the Tundra by May!
Here are some of the stuff marked “Important” by the elders of the future village:

Mushroom Stone: We are not certain if it is a stone or mushroom, but can be used to make potions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/e124d98d94e7832c6014ab6f6423016046f2efa0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/8a8fa53ea4e7d6404fc91459380d5a5649aa4074.png[/img]

notes.title: Craft Hero Enters Early Access: Desert Environment Coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/95025de9afc1e678dc9f6c274aeaf0fcbf7b266e.png[/img]

After fighting against the Demon in Prologue for about one month, Craft Hero finally enters early access! And today we are going to introduce the new content in the new version!

1.The most important update: desert environment. You will now be able to enter desert environment to collect special resources. But be careful, new challenge comes with it too. 
A.Strengthen your weapons: You will be able to upgrade your weapons and armors with Patterns now. 
B.Powerful Defense: You will now be able to build Lighting Generator, using the power of thunder to burn the Demon!
C. Advanced Agriculture: New building Crystal Lamp will allow your plants to grow at nights. And Automatic Receiver can help you collect ripe plants.
D. Magic Energy: To keep these complex machines run well, you need enough energy. The new energy system will make your tow run more efficiently!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/83e70088faf7d2ec9737dbf34344a9c267090475.png[/img]

2.And finally, it’s time to have a new appearance! You can use new building Mirror to change your skin and hair style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42076676/bc25d2153f58eefda08c5430591b33bb1d2ae01b.png[/img]

These are the new contents you will see in our early access. And we will keep updating new environments, tools and other cool stuff in the coming day. And plz follow our Twitter and Discord to support us!

*Some buildings will be unlocked after technical adjustment in the future update. Sorry for the inconvenience and thanks for your understanding.
